root_user.description: Email address (or local user) that receives mail for the root user.

mailhub.description: SMTP relay server (hostname or IP) with optional port (e.g., 'smtp.gmail.com:587').

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption (STARTTLS or implicit TLS) for the connection to the relay.

use_starttls.description: Explicitly use STARTTLS negotiation (ignored if UseTLS is NO).

hostname.description: Hostname to send in the SMTP HELO/EHLO command. Empty means use system hostname.

from_line_override.description: Allow overriding the 'From:' header for root's outgoing mail (set to YES to enable).

auth_user.description: Username for SMTP authentication (if required by relay). Leave blank if not using auth.

auth_pass.description: Password for SMTP authentication (if required). Keep secure (e.g., via file perms).

tls_cert_check.description: Verify the relay's certificate against CA bundle. Disable only in testing (insecure).

rewrite_domain.description: Domain to append to all outgoing 'From:' addresses (e.g., 'example.com').

default_domain.description: Domain to append to addresses missing a domain (e.g., 'localhost').

ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification (e.g., system default).

debug.description: Enable debug logging to stderr (for troubleshooting only).
